generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or cast-shadow field is visible, but basalt tops are repeatedly brighter than vertical faces and column sides have consistent value separation. The aggregate metric cannot override the literal no-lit-side requirement.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad level bench tops and approach shelves count as buildable; exposed vertical bench faces and the arch face count as steep; talus, scree, gullies, and sparse conifer pockets make up the remainder.

crown.method: Median of all eight detected conifer crowns, including every small crown: source widths 18, 19, 26, 37, 39, 43, 46 and 52 px, scaled by 2560/1254; median source width 38 px.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: The tarn and west fall-runoff system were traced bank-to-bank from the native source; filled row envelopes include the complete painted surfaces, ripple highlights, reflections, spray, whitewater, and wash between stones, with smooth binary boundaries and no interior holes.

siteChecks.plateauTarn: present as a round lake on bare middle-bench rock with a continuous vegetation-free shingle rim
siteChecks.windArch: present as a natural basalt arch beside a level bare-rock shelf
siteChecks.tunnelledRidgeTerrain: present as a tall solid north-bench rise with level approach ground and no portal or track
siteChecks.westBenchFall: present as a thin tall fall with connected rock-channel runoff

refusalReasons: The candidate violates the highest-priority lighting rule: repeated bright basalt top planes and darker vertical faces reveal consistent form-side value separation. The task allows a retry only for a non-square result, so no second ImageGen call was made.
openRisks: Exact shoreline judgment, neighbour-pixel stitch quality, site readability, and overall terrain quality remain director and owner visual decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
The wind arch and north tunnel approach are present, but their usable clearances were estimated from the single raster rather than validated against a 3D height field.
